entities.name: Avizoa
entities.description: Flying jellyfish native to Dominaria with tentacles strong enough to lift humans.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: Minotaur who once thought of trapping Avizoa with Squee as bait.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Goblin considered as bait for Avizoa.

entities.name: Nael
entities.description: Yavimayan elf scout who flies using Avizoa.

events.summary: Tahngarth once thought to trap Avizoa using Squee as bait.
events.quote: Tahngarth once thought to trap Avizoa with bait, thinking to use Squee as the bait.

events.summary: Nael learned to fly alongside a flock of avizoa after failed experiments.
events.quote: she found herself soaring above the clouds alongside them

relations.note: Uses Avizoa to fly by attaching a bucket to them
relations.quote: Nael is a Yavimayan elf scout known as the Avizoa Aeronaut who uses Avizoa to fly
